summary.text: Sean Carlson is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Ryan Berman in a race without an incumbent.
Ballotpedia describes Carlson as a U.S. Army veteran and nonprofit director who serves on the Huron Valley School Board.

paragraphs.text: Carlson has served on the Huron Valley Schools board of education in an at-large seat since 2008.
He was re-elected as an incumbent in the November 4, 2014, school board election.
Carlson won the Democratic primary for the Senate seat on August 4, 2026, defeating Cecil George and DC Anderson with 59.3 percent of the vote.
